silentHoursStart.title: Silent Hours — Start Time
silentHoursStart.description: When the fan stops boosting at night. Enter in 24-hour format, e.g. 23:00. Leave blank to disable the schedule.

silentHoursEnd.title: Silent Hours — End Time
silentHoursEnd.description: When the fan resumes boosting in the morning. Enter in 24-hour format, e.g. 07:00. Both start and end must be set for the schedule to activate.

showSilentSwitch.title: Show Silent Hours Switch in Home
showSilentSwitch.description: Adds a Silent Hours on/off switch to your accessory in the Home app. Useful for including in a Goodnight scene or automation. Good for shift workers or irregular schedules.

showHumidity.title: Show Humidity Sensor
showHumidity.description: ⚠️ The fan's humidity reading reflects its internal threshold state and updates infrequently — it is NOT a live sensor reading and is NOT suitable for Siri queries or real-time automations. Only enable if you understand and accept this limitation.

showLight.title: Show Light Sensor
showLight.description: ⚠️ The fan's light reading reflects its internal threshold state and updates infrequently — it is NOT a live lux reading. Confirmed via testing: the value remains static regardless of lighting conditions. Only enable if you understand this limitation.

fans.title: Manually Configured Fans
fans.description: Optional. Leave empty for auto-discovery. Add entries here only to set a custom name or PIN per fan.

mac.title: MAC Address
mac.description: MAC address of the fan — found in the official Pax or Vent-Axia app under About Device.

pin.title: PIN Code
pin.description: 6-digit PIN. Only change if you set a custom PIN in the official app.
